primary_normalization: NFKC; remove Arabic combining vocalization/annotation code points U+0610-U+061A, U+064B-U+065F, U+0670, U+06D6-U+06ED (including Quranic annotation symbols in that range) and tatweel; punctuation to spaces; collapse whitespace; preserve lexical forms and repetitions
diagnostic_normalization: primary normalization plus alef variants أ إ آ ٱ -> ا
aggregation: micro error counts over scored reference units

primary_score_exclusions.I0tWefiPh-0: Reference ends with an untimed [غير واضح] faded span; exclude the complete clip until a shared audio/reference boundary is marked.

limitations: Nine clips from three speakers are reused development material. Results describe this sample only and require Arabic human review.
